The series has a unit root (not stationary). A small p-value rejects it, so the series looks stationary.

front: ADF reject and KPSS not reject means what?
back: The series is stationary. Use it as is. The tests agree.

front: ADF not reject and KPSS reject means what?
back: A unit root. Difference the series and test again.
adfuller(x) returns statistic, p-value, lags, nobs, critical values. kpss(x) returns statistic, p-value, lags, critical values.

front: Name two limits of unit-root tests.
back: Low power on short series, and they are fooled by structural breaks or seasons. Always plot too.
